meta.promptText: Mujhe India mein 3000 rupees ke andar running shoes kharidne hain. Konse lene chahiye?

response.text:
Aapke budget me **best pick** usually woh hota hai jo *daily running*, *comfort*, aur *durability* ka balance de. India me ₹3000 ke andar **Nike Run Defy**, **Skechers Go Run Consistent**, **Puma Voltaic Evo**, **Adidas Duramo SL / Duramo SL 2**, aur **ASICS Jolt 5 / Patriot 13** ko commonly strong budget options maana ja raha hai.[2][1][12]

**Meri short recommendation:**

- **Overall best:** **Nike Run Defy** — lightweight, soft foam cushioning aur daily use ke liye balanced choice.[2][12]
- **Best cushioning:** **Skechers Go Run Consistent** — agar aapko zyada soft feel chahiye ya heel-strike karte hain.[2]
- **Best running-focused pick:** **Puma Voltaic Evo** — running performance ko priority dene ke liye.[12]
- **Reliable beginner option:** **ASICS Jolt 5 / Patriot 13** — beginner-friendly daily runs ke liye commonly recommend kiye ja rahe hain.[1]
- **Good all-rounder:** **Adidas Duramo SL / SL 2** — running + gym + casual use ke liye theek choice.[1]

**Agar aap 2–5 km daily run karte hain**, to inme se koi ek le sakte hain: **Nike Run Defy**, **Skechers Go Run Consistent**, ya **Puma Voltaic Evo**.[2][12]  
**Agar aap beginner ho aur safe, simple option chahiye**, to **ASICS Jolt 5** ya **Adidas Duramo SL** lena sensible rahega.[1]

**Kya avoid karna chahiye:**  
Sirf looks ke basis par **fashion/lifestyle shoes** mat lein; running ke liye better hai ki shoe me cushioning, breathable upper, aur decent rubber outsole ho.[3][6]

**Quick rule:**
- **Wide feet:** ASICS / Skechers try karein  
- **Soft cushion chahiye:** Skechers  
- **Lightweight chahiye:** Nike Run Defy  
- **General daily running:** Adidas Duramo SL / ASICS Jolt 5  
- **Running-first:** Puma Voltaic Evo[2][12][1]

Agar aap chahein, main aapke liye **₹3000 ke andar top 5 shoes ki ek simple shortlist** bana deta hoon — **men’s**, **women’s**, ya **wide-feet** ke hisaab se.
